title: Rooftop Flow
blurb: A 530 m route across six sections with seven checkpoints and a red finish gate.

verification.notes: Dark menu; bright city with glass towers; sprint auto-vaults the first red box, then stops against a head-height slide beam (the harness never slides), so the later sprint frames are filled by the beam. Resumed once after a Go usage-limit stop. Model's bot completed the route in 55.5 s.
